question: Select the most appropriate answer for blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**possess**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage states that the people of India have the power and potential to realize the Prime Minister's vision.
 
• The suitable word should indicate that the people already have this power and potential.
 
• "**Possess**" fits well
